pandas.read_excel

pandas 3.1.1 · Input and output · function

Read a worksheet or multiple worksheets. Use sheet_name to choose sheets and header to identify column labels.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

pd.read_excel(…) Full signature
pd.read_excel(
    io,
    sheet_name=0,
    *,
    header=0,
    names=None,
    index_col=None,
    usecols=None,
    dtype=None,
    engine=None,
    converters=None,
    true_values=None,
    false_values=None,
    skiprows=None,
    nrows=None,
    na_values=None,
    keep_default_na=True,
    na_filter=True,
    verbose=False,
    parse_dates=False,
    date_format=None,
    thousands=None,
    decimal='.',
    comment=None,
    skipfooter=0,
    storage_options=None,
    dtype_backend=…,
    engine_kwargs=None,
)
